newsitem.title: USA: Woolworth sells German shoe-store chain. [CORRECTED 21:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Woolworth sells German shoe-store chain. [CORRECTED 21:40 GMT]

text.p: Woolworth Corp said on Monday it is selling Moderna Shuh-Center GmbH, its German family shoe store chain to Andre' Schuhland GmbH (corrects company name) for an undisclosed sum.

Woolworth said the sale of the 76-store chain completes its disposal of its non-core German shoe-store businesses, allowing the company to focus on its 374 general-merchandise stores in that country. (Corrects to clarify extent of disposals)
Andre' Schuhland is a wholly owned subsidiary of Andre' Deutschland GmbH.
